name: credential-rescue
description: Credentials Rescue — the fleet plugin for machine-level credential repair. Two tracks off one seam: salmon-run (Salmon-track key cutover for lanes), paseo-rescue (single-entry Repair-Paseo: classify, pin, worker/app restart, verify), plus aws-store restore and the unattended watch (cutover + Paseo repair on EXHAUSTED only). Pick the runbook that matches the symptom and load only that one.

interface.longDescription: Two tracks off one seam: Salmon Run lane key-pool cutover (Switch-OpencodeGoKey: User env + auth.json + defaultCodingKey first in pool order), then the single-entry Paseo repair (Repair-Paseo: classify BINARY/NAME/KEY, pin provider env, worker restart with FullApp fallback, verify) — plus ~/.aws store restore and the unattended overnight watch (cutover + Paseo repair on EXHAUSTED only).
defaultPrompt: GO1 is exhausted - switch to GO5 and prove it.
Paseo still uses the old key after the cutover - fix it.
